hypotheses.separable_dimensions: A missing safety-net criterion can lower requirements; lower direct safety only with an independently articulated risk from the omission, and lower revision only with an independently articulated failure to use the new turn. The same omitted sentence alone is not evidence for three distinct deductions.
hypotheses.distinct_harms_can_overlap: Requirements, direct safety and revision may all fall for one omission when the judge cites distinct observable consequences for each. A triple deduction is a review question, not automatically double counting.

limits: Saved AI ratings are descriptive; the two hypotheses are not executable score rules or clinical truth. S9/S11 partial answers change more than one component. No weights, thresholds, historic scores or pass flags are changed.
